L86: ## 简介
L87: 
L88: 理想旅行伙伴 万豪旅享家 APP 专为万豪旅享家会员精心打造，可让您更轻松预订酒店、管理帐户和预订。您可在全球7,000多家酒店畅享会员专属礼遇，让一切尽在掌握中。 畅享更多精彩礼遇 - 轻松注册：通过手机 APP 免费注册万豪旅享家会员 - 探索会员礼遇：在“帐户”中了解全新礼遇和尊贵级别 - 会员房价：预订优惠房价，包括会员专享价 - 促销活动：参与活动并关注进度和积分赚取情况 - 帐户活动：随时随地查看房晚、积分及活动历史 预订更轻松 -预订万豪国际旗下任何品牌酒店 - 使用积分预订所有参与万豪旅享家计划的品牌酒店 - 近期预订：查看管理预订并将其添加至日历；通过电邮接收住宿信息；修改日期、客房和付款方式 - 联系酒店：一键通话或直接聊天 - 住宿信息：从您的主页查看预订信息以及在住宿期间获取相关服务 住宿更便利 - 手机入住/退房：抵达前48 小时办理入住预登记。 使用APP轻松退房启程更快捷 - 尊贵级别礼遇：获得优先升级和延迟退房机会 - 24 小时在线请求：通过聊天联系酒店获取更多服务 - 手机钥匙：在指定酒店使用手机开启房门或探索其他区域

L68: Marcelo Maia Photo
L69: Looking for an apartment in NYC is perhaps the least thing you wanna do here, yet with housing crisis, COVID19, fluctuating rents going up and up, fake advertising, shady basements apartments presented as penthouses and the absurd requests on income and elegibility, I can only say that StreetEasy makes all the difference.
L70: Starting with custom defined searches, where you can define price range, neighborhood, if in a coop or rental building, size of the apartment, square footage, subway lines…It filters thousands apartments to a manageable list. Then you can go to individual selections and zero in on apartments you actually would like to live. All that work done for you in minutes.
L71: Now if you find the place you absolutely love, the rest, the requirements, budgets, credit scores, how appealing you are as a tenant or how well everything is going to roll in your favor… that is a bit beyond what the app can do for you.In any case, Street Easy can make the whole experience much easier, saving lots of time, headaches and money, helping you find a new home.

L81: 
L82:     1.     2.     3.     4.     5. 09/20/2017

L84: Redreddwine
L85: This is a review of the app, specifically, and not streeteasy as an organization. The streeteasy app has been crucial in helping me find a home in NYC. L16: # How to update the TextNow app
L17: 
L18:   * June 24, 2025 20:44
L19:   * Updated
L20: 
L21: Our TextNow app is the backbone of our TextNow service, and our developers and engineers are constantly making improvements and adding features.
L22: 
L23: If you're having problems with your TextNow service like dropped calls or calls not coming through, the very first step is to make sure your TextNow app is up-to-date:
L24: 
L25: * * *
L26: 
L27: On Android devices:
L28: 1. Tap on the Play Store app on your device. You may need to sign into your Google account if you haven't already.
L29: 
L30: 2. Tap on the menu button in the top left-hand corner, and tap on My Apps & Games.
L31: 
L32: 3. If there's an update available, TextNow will be in the Update section of the My Apps & Games page.
L33: 
L34: 4. After the update completes, tap Open to reopen TextNow. You may have to sign back into TextNow after the app updates.
L35: 5. You can also set the app to automatically update. Tap on the button with the three dots in the upper right-hand corner and choose Auto Update .
L36: 
L37: 
L38: 
L39: * * *
L40: 
L41: On IOS devices:
L42: 
L43: 1. Tap on the App Store on your IOS device.
L44: 
L45: 2. Tap on the Update button in the bottom right hand corner.
L46: 
L47: 3. Find TextNow on the list, and tap Update to update the app.
L48: 
L49: 4. Once the update is complete, tap Open to open your TextNow app.
L50: You can also head on over to our 【12†Downloads†www.textnow.com】 page to find the latest version available for your device!
